success.description: The targets are struck by a venomous ball of webs. Each target suffers -2 damage and gains the Entangled condition until freed. A character can free himself (or an ally can free him) with an Average (2{Da}) Athletics or Coordination check as an action. This

bane.description: The check gains a Misfortune Die. Draw 1 critical wound and suffers fatigue equal to its severity. Then return the critical to the deck.
Add 2 recharge tokens to this card as the goblin riders squabble.

chaosStar.description: One goblin rider gets stuck and is flung with the web. He gains the Entangled condition and becomes engaged with the target engagement.

conservative.requirements: Equipped with a flinger, target engagement within medium range. You may attack a target at long range by adding {Dc} to the dice pool. For each goblin rider, add {Dm} to the dice pool.
conservative.name: Venomous Web
